environment.profile: thin LTO, one codegen unit, locked dependencies
environment.scope: Temporary Kubernetes pod on shared homelab worker. Different physical cores for server and client; not exclusive core ownership.

measurement.order: Alternates baseline/candidate order for each pair
measurement.cpu: Process user+system ticks divided by all completed requests, 100 Hz clock. Includes warmup.
measurement.latency: Custom k6 trend records responses completing after five seconds.
measurement.rss: Process RSS after run, not peak.
measurement.rps: Whole-run rate includes the fixed-rate ramp. steady_requests covers the final 20 seconds.
measurement.pilot: 10s, no ramp, 64 VUs. Failed thresholds retained.
measurement.fixed: Five-second ramp from 100/s to 5000/s, followed by 20s at 5000/s. First phase 64 VUs; admitted follow-up 96 VUs. The 256-VU diagnostic exceeded admission and was aborted.

admission_diagnostic.reason: Pool exceeds configured connection allowance. Count equality failed; stopped before running the candidate. Not a performance comparison.

allocation_probe.comparison: Identical to baseline; three final Linux release runs

reproduction.homelab_runner:
import subprocess, pathlib, json, time, csv, argparse
out=pathlib.Path('artifacts/lean-gains');base=['kubectl','--context','homelab','-n','maximus-perf-gains','exec','measure']
def cmd(container,*args):return base+['-c',container,'--',*args]
def read(container,*args):return subprocess.check_output(cmd(container,*args),text=True)
def stats():
 return json.loads(read('server','python3','-c',"import json,os,pathlib;pid=pathlib.Path('/work/server.pid').read_text().strip();s=pathlib.Path('/proc/'+pid+'/stat').read_text().split(')')[1].split();print(json.dumps(dict(ticks=int(s[11])+int(s[12]),rss=int(s[21])*os.sysconf('SC_PAGE_SIZE'),hz=os.sysconf('SC_CLK_TCK'))))"))
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--vus',type=int,default=64);p.add_argument('--variants',default='before,lookup');p.add_argument('--label',required=True);p.add_argument('--repeats',type=int,default=5);p.add_argument('--body',default='1024');p.add_argument('--rate',default='0');p.add_argument('--path',default='/echo');p.add_argument('--duration',default='35s');a=p.parse_args()
rows=[];variants=a.variants.split(',')
for n in range(a.repeats):
 for v in variants[n%len(variants):]+variants[:n%len(variants)]:
  key=f'{a.label}-{v}-{n}'
  read('server','sh','-c',f'MAXIMUS_CERT=/work/cert.pem MAXIMUS_KEY=/work/key.pem PROTOCOL=h2 WORKERS=1 /work/results/pin 4 /work/results/server-{v} maximus >/work/server.log 2>&1 & echo $! >/work/server.pid')
  try:
   for _ in range(50):
    if 'ready' in read('server','cat','/work/server.log'):break
    time.sleep(.1)
   else:raise RuntimeError('server not ready')
   before=stats()
   env=['env',f'PATHNAME={a.path}',f'BODY_BYTES={a.body}',f'DURATION={a.duration}',f'VUS={a.vus}','SSL_CERT_FILE=/work/cert.pem',f'RESULT=/work/results/{key}.json']
   if a.rate!='0':env.append(f'RATE={a.rate}')
   t=time.monotonic()
   with (out/f'{key}.log').open('w') as f:r=subprocess.run(cmd('client',*env,'/work/results/pin','80','k6','run','--quiet','/work/load.js'),stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
   elapsed=time.monotonic()-t;after=stats()
   s=json.loads(read('server','cat',f'/work/results/{key}.json'));(out/f'{key}.json').write_text(json.dumps(s))
   m=s['metrics'];val=lambda k,f,default=0:m.get(k,{}).get('values',{}).get(f,default)
   count=val('http_reqs','count');assert count==val('starts','count')==val('iterations','count') and count>0
   row=dict(phase=a.label,variant=v,repeat=n,path=a.path,body=int(a.body),rate=int(a.rate),requests=count,rps=val('http_reqs','rate'),cpu_us=(after['ticks']-before['ticks'])/before['hz']*1e6/count,steady_requests=val('steady_requests','count'),p99_ms=val('steady_latency','p(99)'),p999_ms=val('steady_latency','p(99.9)'),rss=after['rss'],failures=val('http_req_failed','passes'),checks_failed=val('checks','fails'),dropped=val('dropped_iterations','count'),exit=r.returncode,wall_seconds=elapsed)
   rows.append(row)
   with (out/f'{a.label}.csv').open('w') as f:w=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=list(row),lineterminator='\n');w.writeheader();w.writerows(rows)
   print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
  finally:read('server','sh','-c','kill $(cat /work/server.pid); sleep 0.2')

limitations: Small repeated experiment, not a universal no-regression guarantee.
Shared hosts; task builds and competing load are excluded on the homelab during timed trials.
Raw tooling, corpora, binaries, certificates and logs remain ignored local artifacts.
